name: Elisabetha Birgert
bioAdditions: FamilySearch (as 'Elisabetha Birkhert') gives her birth in 1618 at Fockenberg-Limbach and her death at Berschweiler on 13 Sep 1685, and names her parents as Conradt Birgert and Anna Eva Jacob (S1). Her marriage to Caspar Grub on 9 Jan 1642 is indexed in 'Germany Marriages' with Conradt Birkhert as her father. Her attached records include her appearance as the mother 'Elisabetha Grub' in the baptism of a son Johann (S1). None of these was read in Round 4.

relationships.evidence: 1642 marriage index names her father Conradt Birkhert (per FamilySearch)
